_comment: Simulated/test recorder config (offline, no gateway connected). Create the store first: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from research_store import init_store; init_store('<store_root>')". calendar_spec uses the revised 02I seal grammar (tz:<IANA> = display/normalization evidence ONLY, never a trading-calendar claim; trading_date stays unknown without explicit source evidence). CTP TickData observations are recorded as quote/snapshot observations, never as exchange trade-by-trade. Simulated and production sources must use separate configs/sessions.
